title: Hall transports from Taub-NUT AdS black holes
summary: We compute Hall transport coefficients associated with Taub-NUT AdS black holes in four space-time dimensions using the probe D-brane approach. In particular, we examine the effects due to the NUT parameter ($n$), or equivalently, the novel frame-dragging on the holographic charge transport properties. In our analysis, we treat the external electric field as a constant background, while varying the magnetic field ($B$) from small to finite.
